isolated_instruction: Speak this line naturally in a casual conversational tone.

scene.setting: Two housemates discover that an empty milk carton was returned to the refrigerator. The disagreement is familiar, low-stakes, and gradually turns playful.

turns.speaker: rowan
turns.text: You put the empty carton back in the fridge.
turns.context_instruction: Say this to a familiar housemate with dry, restrained annoyance after discovering the empty carton. This is an observation, not an angry confrontation.

turns.speaker: mira
turns.text: I was going to replace it.
turns.context_instruction: Reply quickly with a slightly defensive excuse. You know the other speaker is right, but you are not ready to concede yet.

turns.speaker: rowan
turns.context_instruction: Respond with weary familiarity, as if this exact excuse has already been heard. Keep the delivery quiet and conversational rather than theatrical.

turns.speaker: mira
turns.text: Yesterday, it still had milk in it.
turns.context_instruction: Offer a calmly pedantic technicality while beginning to find the disagreement amusing. Sound pleased with the loophole but not triumphant.

turns.speaker: rowan
turns.context_instruction: Answer with flat disbelief and reluctant amusement. The friendship is intact; the absurd measurement is the joke.

turns.speaker: mira
turns.context_instruction: Deliver a light, self-satisfied punchline after realizing the argument is funny. Keep it warm, understated, and natural.
